$comment: The cities, in travel order (MowConfig CITIES). level: the file in levels/ (without .json). map: the map shot's name (images/non-preload/map/<map>.webp, the editor's Map shots). guide: false hides the guide arrows (the player knows the game by then). keepGear: travelling on from here keeps the mower, upgrades and money (the tutorial); otherwise the next city starts from scratch (prestige: its bonus is the reward). comingSoon: a card on the City Complete screen, not playable yet.
